scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --filter modernjs-ssr-data-loader_remote dev" "wait-on --timeout 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:3061/ http-get://127.0.0.1:3061/static/mf-manifest.json && pnpm --filter modernjs-ssr-data-loader_host dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter modernjs-ssr-data-loader_remote build && pnpm --filter modernjs-ssr-data-loader_host build
scripts.serve: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --filter modernjs-ssr-data-loader_remote serve" "wait-on --timeout 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:3061/ http-get://127.0.0.1:3061/static/mf-manifest.json && pnpm --filter modernjs-ssr-data-loader_host serve"
